messages:
elaine: FYI GlobePay hitting sustained 5xx + timeouts on hosted inference in nyc1. Customers reporting long tail p99s and lots of request-level 504s. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/GP-4621

ingress-bot: ALERT: cluster=nyc1 ingress_queue_utilization=98% (rule=ingress_queue_high) — affected pods: batcher-*-nyc1 (12)

mike: Any sample request IDs or traces? Is this multi-tenant spike or single-tenant?

elaine: single-tenant spike but scoping to a couple of high-rate keys. sample trace: trace_id=8af3c2b1. Logs show repeated enqueue failures: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z enqueue_push: tenant=globepay enqueue_depth=1024 max_depth=1024 err=queue_full
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z batcher_wait: pending_batches=420 continuous_backlog=3800 avg_wait_ms=3200
2026-03-17T09:12:04Z request_fail: id=8af3c2b1 status=504 reason=enqueue_timeout
```

elaine: Also seeing continuous_batch_pending spike in grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/model-serving/ingress?orgId=1&var-cluster=nyc1 (p95 queue_wait=3.8s, p99=9.1s)

sam: Can we throttle GlobePay temporarily and route them to a fallback smaller model? Would buy time.

ops-oncall: Proposed mitigations: 1) emergency increase ingress queue_depth from 1024->2048 for cluster nyc1 2) scale batcher pool +2 replicas 3) apply tenant rate-limit globe=10rps 4) enable fallback to quantized-variant v1-q8 for that tenant. Doing 1 & 2 now. Command: `infractl scale batcher --cluster nyc1 --replicas +2`

mike: Repro script to validate locally if needed: 
```
# simulate high qps to ingress
hey -n 20000 -c 200 -m POST -D payload.json https://ingress.nyc1.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

elaine: support notified GlobePay (dina) and asked for exact peak windows and sample payloads. Dina: any customer comms update?

dina (support): Told them we're throttling to reduce errors and that we're applying mitigations. Asked for ETA for full fix. They've acknowledged. I'm sharing request examples when they come in.

ingress-bot: ACTION: applied patch -> cluster=nyc1 queue_depth=2048 (graceful apply), scaled batcher replicas: 12 -> 14.

ops-oncall: Also turned on short-circuit fallback for tenant globepay -> model=small-q4 for requests with tokens>1200. Command: `routerctl set-fallback --tenant globepay --model small-q4`

mike: After changes, metrics look better: continuous_batch_pending down from ~3800 -> ~420, avg_queue_wait ~3400ms -> ~600ms, p99 dropping from 9s -> ~1.3s. Still watching.

elaine: Customer reports reduced 5xxs, still a handful of timeouts during windows. We'll keep throttles in place until full mitigation.

sam: Root cause hypothesis: tenant produced sustained microbursts with lots of long-sequence requests that saturate KV cache + continuous batching window — queue headroom exhausted. Need follow-ups: - add tenant-level burst protection (sliding window) - auto-failover to lower-latency model when queue_wait>2s - revisit default queue_depth/backpressure thresholds

ops-oncall: Agree. I'll open follow-up runbook task and post PIT ticket. For now mitigation worked. Marking incident as contained. :white_check_mark:
